name: Valaliky (Slovakia)
description: A white field within a red border, the hoist half quartered red and white (red in the upper hoist and lower fly quarters), ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature V-84/97.
